selected_model: After action effects and resource post-commit have settled and an explicit ordinary action task is SUCCESS, require that task owner to equal the active ordinary actor. Set that actor's remaining action delay to ActionDelayDistance/speed with ActionDelayDistance=10000. Stably sort the supplied eligible ordinary list by remaining delay while preserving the prior action-list order on equal delays, subtract the selected delay from every eligible candidate, and make the first candidate active.
